{{External|rs=Zamorak robe (bottom)|rsc=Robe of Zamorak (bottom)|dw=Zamorak Robe Legs}} {{Confuse|Zamorak robe legs}} {{Infobox Item |name = Zamorak monk bottom |image = [[File:Zamorak monk bottom.png]] |release = [[28 May]] [[2002]] |update = Latest RuneScape News (28 May 2002) |members = No |quest = No |tradeable = Yes |equipable = Yes |stackable = No |noteable = Yes |options = Wear, Drop |examine = A robe worn by worshippers of Zamorak. |value = 30 |weight = 0.907 |exchange = Yes |id = 1033 }} [[File:Zamorak monk bottom detail.png|left|110px]] The '''Zamorak monk bottom''' is part of the [[Zamorak monk robes]] set. They are bright red, and like the related [[Zamorak monk top]] they are dropped by [[Disciple of Iban|disciples of Iban]] and [[monks of Zamorak]]. Zamorak monk robes are commonly used by mages in the [[Wilderness]] due to providing decent [[Prayer]] and [[Magic]] bonuses and being easy to replace if lost. They can also be used to telegrab [[Wine of Zamorak]] at the [[Chaos Temple (Asgarnia)]] without being attacked. The Zamorak monk bottom counts as a [[Zamorak item]] in the [[God Wars Dungeon]]. The Zamorak monk bottom is notable for being the only [[Legs slot table (F2P)|free-to-play leg slot]] item with a [[Magic]] attack bonus. ==Combat stats== {{Infobox Bonuses |astab = 0 |aslash = 0 |acrush = 0 |amagic = 2 |arange = 0 |dstab = 0 |dslash = 0 |dcrush = 0 |dmagic = 3 |drange = 0 |str = 0 |rstr = 0 |mdmg = 0 |prayer = 3 |slot = legs |image = [[File:Zamorak monk bottom equipped male.png|150px]] |altimage = [[File:Zamorak monk bottom equipped female.png|150px]] }} ==Item sources== {{Drop sources|Zamorak monk bottom}} ==Used in recommended equipment== {{Used in recommended equipment|Zamorak monk bottom}} ==Gallery== Zamorak monk robes equipped male.png|Zamorak monk robes on body type A.
